The '''11th Flight''' was a [[Flight group/Legends|flight]] of [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|''Vulture''-class]] [[Battle droid/Legends|droid]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] in the service of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
The [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy's]] 11th [[Flight group/Legends|Flight]] was comprised of [[Color/Legends|mottled]] [[gray]] and [[blue]] [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|''Vulture''-class]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. On the ground, the droids were not very maneuverable, but rerouting power from targeting systems to shields and weapons made the 11th Flight formidable when grounded. Despite this, the 11th had the highest-rated maneuverability during flight&mdash;along with the ''Vulture'' [[Droid/Legends|droids]] of the 103rd Flight Elite&mdash;higher even than the droid [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] of the 11th Flight Elite.<ref name="mini" />

==History==
The 11th Flight of [[Battle droid/Legends|droid]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] fought during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="mini" />

==Behind the scenes==
11th Flight was represented with a miniature in the [[Star Wars PocketModel TCG: Base Set|initial release]] of the ''[[Star Wars PocketModel TCG]]''.<ref name="mini" />
